title: Months of Overcharge Interest on Commercial Natural Gas Supply Swing Excess Credits
content:
The months of overcharge interest on a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing excess rebill credit are whole calendar months counted from an anchor to the correction date, a month counting only once the correction date's day of the month has reached the anchor's day of the month.

The anchor follows how the cycle's price was published. The cycle's notice is the monthly index price notice whose effective date is the cycle's billing period start:

- when that notice is dated after the cycle's billing period start and was delivered by mail, the anchor is the cycle's billing period start;
- when that notice is dated after the billing period start and was delivered by email, the anchor is the cycle's billing period end;
- otherwise the anchor is the posted date of the swing excess line.

## Anchor table

| Notice date compared with the billing period start | Delivery channel of the notice | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| After | Mail | Billing period start of the cycle |
| After | Email | Billing period end of the cycle |
| After | Any other channel | Posted date of the swing excess line |
| On or before | Any | Posted date of the swing excess line |

## Counting whole months (hypothetical anchors and correction dates)

| Anchor | Correction date | Whole months |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-01-15 | 2025-06-14 | 4 (the 15th of June has not been reached) |
| 2025-01-15 | 2025-06-15 | 5 |
| 2025-01-31 | 2025-06-30 | 4 (day 30 has not reached day 31) |
| 2024-11-20 | 2025-02-20 | 3 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A cycle runs from 2025-01-14 to 2025-02-12 and its swing excess line was posted on 2025-02-20. The cycle's monthly index price notice was dated 2025-01-17 and delivered by mail, so the anchor is 2025-01-14; for a correction dated 2025-07-10 the months of overcharge interest are 5. Had the notice been delivered by email, the anchor would be 2025-02-12 and the months 4. Had the notice been dated 2025-01-14 or earlier, the anchor would be 2025-02-20 and the months 4.
